name: amness
description: A coding agent for any model, in your terminal or as a desktop app: streaming chat TUI, permission modes, plan mode, undo, memory, MCP, with a small reliability harness underneath. OpenAI (Responses API), Claude, and local models.
author: amirhossein jofreh <366054+amirsdream@users.noreply.github.com>

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "const f=require('fs');f.cpSync('cli/desktop/ui','dist/cli/desktop/ui',{recursive:true});f.cpSync('cli/desktop/assets','dist/cli/desktop/assets',{recursive:true});for(const x of ['electron-main.cjs','electron-preload.cjs'])f.copyFileSync('cli/desktop/'+x,'dist/cli/desktop/'+x)"
scripts.test:desktop-ui: node test/desktop-ui/run.ts && node test/desktop-ui/agents.ts && node test/desktop-ui/run.ts test/desktop-ui/narrow-check.js --size 1100x720 && node test/desktop-ui/run.ts test/desktop-ui/prefs-check.js && node test/desktop-ui/run.ts test/desktop-ui/chats-check.js --chats && node test/desktop-ui/run.ts test/desktop-ui/edit-check.js
